info.title: ADSP Planner Service API
info.description:
AI-powered conversational business planning service for the Alberta Digital Service Platform (ADSP).

**Classification: Protected B** (GoA deliberative process content per ATIA s.23).

All endpoints require Keycloak JWT authentication except /health/* and /metrics.

INT-001 (Anthropic Claude API) is STUB/fail-closed pending resolution of:
- OPEN-001: Anthropic API contract approval
- OPEN-002: API key provisioning
- OPEN-006: IM policy approval for out-of-jurisdiction data transfer

Roles:
- `planner-user`: create/read/update own sessions; read patterns; consult specialists
- `planner-admin`: full access to all tenant sessions; manage patterns; view audit log
- `tenant-admin`: equivalent to planner-admin for their tenant

Log redaction: conversation content (conversation_message.content), business model data,
and hypothesis summaries are redacted in structured logs via Winston pino-style redaction.
Fields redacted: content, summary, reasoning, requestPayload, responsePayload, exportData.

x-security.tlsEnforcement: TLS 1.2 minimum; HSTS enforced via helmet() middleware (max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains)
x-security.auditLogging: HMAC-chained audit events per BR-008 and SYSREQ-020; AUDIT_SIGNING_KEY env var
x-security.dataResidency: Canada — Alberta Government ADSP platform. INT-001 out-of-jurisdiction transfer blocked pending OPEN-001/002/006.
x-security.inputValidation: Zod schema validation on all write endpoints; message max 10000 chars (SYSREQ-024)
x-security.rateLimiting: express-rate-limit on /messages and /specialists endpoints; 429 with Retry-After on breach

tags.name: sessions
tags.description: Planning session lifecycle — create, list, retrieve, update status, archive. Serves UC-001 (create), UC-006 (resume/list/update), SYSREQ-022 (archive/retention).

tags.name: messages
tags.description: Conversation messaging — send user message to Planning Agent, retrieve conversation history. Triggers LLM inference via INT-001 stub (fail-closed). Serves UC-002.

tags.name: business-model
tags.description: Business model retrieval and concept correction. Returns BusinessModel with embedded BusinessConcept list. Serves UC-003.

tags.name: hypotheses
tags.description: Solution hypothesis listing, retrieval, and status lifecycle transitions (accept/reject/supersede). Enforces BR-010 state machine. Serves UC-004.

tags.name: specialists
tags.description: Specialist agent consultation — delegate to form/pdf/comment/notification stubs (INT-003..006, all Stub/fail-closed). Serves UC-005.

tags.name: patterns
tags.description: Business pattern library CRUD. Write endpoints require planner-admin+ (BR-007). Calls INT-002 Config Service stub. Serves UC-007.

tags.name: exports
tags.description: Session plan export — assembles and serialises session state to portable JSON. Serves UC-008.

tags.name: audit
tags.description: Administrative audit log read-only view. Requires planner-admin+ (BR-007). HMAC-chained AuditEvent collection (BR-008, SYSREQ-020). Serves UC-010.

tags.name: health
tags.description: ADSP liveness and readiness probes. No JWT required. Serves SYSREQ-023.

tags.name: metrics
tags.description: Prometheus metrics endpoint. No JWT required. Serves SYSREQ-023 (observability).

tags.name: user-management
tags.description: Current user context endpoint. Returns the authenticated user's own profile and role context within the planner service. Full user management (invite, deactivate, role assignment) is delegated to the ADSP Access Service (Keycloak). Serves the user-management sitemap page (FAC-S4-014).

post.description: Creates a new PlanningSession document in MongoDB with status 'active', plus an empty linked BusinessModel. Publishes session-created domain event via INT-007 stub. Enforces tenantId/userId from JWT per BR-001. Serves UC-001.

get.description: Returns paginated list of PlanningSession records. planner-user sees own sessions only; planner-admin/tenant-admin see all tenant sessions (BR-007). All queries tenant-scoped per BR-001. Admin invocation is operationId listAllSessions (same endpoint, role-based filter). Serves UC-006, UC-010.

get.summary: Get a planning session by ID
get.description: Retrieves full session state including status, title, businessModelId, timestamps. planner-user may only retrieve own sessions; planner-admin may retrieve any tenant session. Serves UC-006.

patch.summary: Update a planning session (status or title)
patch.description: Updates session status (e.g., active, paused, completed) and/or title. Sets lastResumedAt when transitioning to 'active'. Publishes session-updated domain event via INT-007 stub. Serves UC-006, SYSREQ-011.

delete.description: Soft-archives the session by setting status='archived' and archivedAt timestamp. Hard deletion is handled by the scheduled retention job (SYSREQ-022). Publishes session-archived domain event via INT-007 stub. Serves SYSREQ-022.

post.summary: Send a message to the Planning Agent
post.description: Persists the user ConversationMessage, assembles LLM context, and calls INT-001 (Anthropic Claude API). INT-001 is currently STUB/fail-closed — the stub returns HTTP 503 pending OPEN-001, OPEN-002, and OPEN-006 resolution. On live integration, the assistant response is streamed, parsed for business concepts, and used to update BusinessModel. PatternMatchingService runs post-update (BR-005). If confidenceScore reaches 70 (BR-004), HypothesisGenerationService is triggered. Rate-limited per SYSREQ-018. Message content max 10000 chars (SYSREQ-024). Serves UC-002, SYSREQ-017. [IMPL-DEFERRED: INT-001]

X-Integration-Stubbed.description: Present when INT-001 is stub: value=INT-001

get.summary: List conversation messages for a session
get.description: Returns paginated conversation history for the session. Messages are append-only per BR-008 (conversation_message). planner-user may only access own sessions. Serves UC-002.

get.summary: Get the business model for a session
get.description: Returns the BusinessModel document with embedded BusinessConcept list and ConceptRelationship graphs. Serves UC-003.

patch.summary: Update concept types in the business model
patch.description: Allows users to correct conceptType classifications on individual BusinessConcepts. Validates against BusinessConceptType enum per BR-006. Increments model version. Returns HTTP 409 on concurrent version conflict (optimistic locking). Serves UC-003.

get.summary: List solution hypotheses for a session
get.description: Returns paginated list of SolutionHypothesis records for the session. Hypotheses are generated when BusinessModel confidenceScore reaches 70 (BR-004). planner-user may only access own sessions. Serves UC-004.
Retrieves a single SolutionHypothesis by ID. Serves UC-004.

patch.summary: Update the status of a solution hypothesis
patch.description: Transitions the hypothesis status per BR-010 state machine: draft → proposed → accepted | rejected | superseded. Returns HTTP 422 for invalid state transitions. Publishes hypothesis-generated event via INT-007 stub on acceptance. Serves UC-004.

post.description: Creates a SpecialistRequest and delegates to the appropriate specialist stub (INT-003 Form Service, INT-004 PDF Service, INT-005 Comment Service, INT-006 Notification Service). All specialist integrations are currently STUB/fail-closed returning HTTP 503. Interface contracts pending OPEN-005. Planning Agent falls back to general guidance on stub failure. Enforces specialist availability gate per BR-009. Rate-limited per SYSREQ-018. Timeout: 60s per SWREQ-007. Serves UC-005. [IMPL-DEFERRED: INT-003] [IMPL-DEFERRED: INT-004] [IMPL-DEFERRED: INT-005] [IMPL-DEFERRED: INT-006]

X-Integration-Stubbed.description: Present when specialist is stub: value=INT-003|INT-004|INT-005|INT-006

get.summary: Get a specialist request and its response
get.description: Retrieves a SpecialistRequest with its associated SpecialistResponse (if completed). Serves UC-005.

Returns paginated list of active business patterns from Config Service (INT-002 stub). INT-002 is Stub/lookup-empty — returns empty list pending ADSP Config Service provisioning (OPEN-004). Available to all authenticated roles. Serves UC-007. [IMPL-DEFERRED: INT-002]

X-Integration-Stubbed.description: Present when INT-002 Config Service is stub: value=INT-002

post.description: Creates a new business pattern in Config Service (INT-002 stub, returns 503). Requires planner-admin or tenant-admin role (BR-007). Writes audit entry per BR-008. Serves UC-007. [IMPL-DEFERRED: INT-002]

get.summary: Get a business pattern by ID
get.description: Retrieves a specific business pattern from Config Service (INT-002 stub). Serves UC-007. [IMPL-DEFERRED: INT-002]

put.description: Updates a business pattern in Config Service (INT-002 stub, returns 503). Requires planner-admin or tenant-admin role (BR-007). Writes audit entry per BR-008. Serves UC-007. [IMPL-DEFERRED: INT-002]

delete.description: Permanently deletes a business pattern from Config Service (INT-002 stub, returns 503). Requires planner-admin or tenant-admin role (BR-007). Writes audit entry per BR-008. Serves UC-007. [IMPL-DEFERRED: INT-002]

put.description: Soft-deactivates a business pattern in Config Service (INT-002 stub, returns 503). Requires planner-admin or tenant-admin role (BR-007). Writes audit entry per BR-008. Serves UC-007. [IMPL-DEFERRED: INT-002]

post.summary: Export a planning session to portable JSON
post.description: Assembles a SessionExport from PlanningSession, BusinessModel, SolutionHypotheses, and ConversationMessages. planner-user may only export own sessions; planner-admin may export any tenant session (BR-001, BR-007). Serves UC-008.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of SessionExport records for the given session. planner-user may only list exports for own sessions; planner-admin may list exports for any tenant session (BR-007). Serves UC-008.

get.summary: Get a session export by ID
get.description: Retrieves a SessionExport document. planner-user may only access own session exports. Serves UC-008.

Returns paginated HMAC-chained AuditEvent records. Requires planner-admin or tenant-admin role (BR-007). Access to this endpoint itself generates an audit entry per BR-008. Serves UC-010, SYSREQ-020. Classification: Protected A (audit_event entity).

Verifies the HMAC chain integrity of the audit log over a specified index range. Returns a verification result indicating whether the chain is intact and, if not, the index at which the first failure was detected. Requires planner-admin+ (BR-007). Serves SYSREQ-020.

parameters.name: startIndex
parameters.description: Start of the index range to verify (inclusive, 0-based)

parameters.name: endIndex
parameters.description: End of the index range to verify (inclusive, 0-based)

verified.description: True if all HMAC hashes in the range are valid

failedAtIndex.description: Index of the first failed hash (present only when verified is false)

get.summary: Get a single audit event by ID
get.description: Retrieves a single AuditEvent by its ID. Requires planner-admin+ (BR-007). Serves UC-010.

Returns the authenticated user's own profile and planner-service role context (tenantId, userId, roles). This endpoint fulfills the user-management sitemap page's API requirement — full user management (invite, deactivate, role assignment) is delegated to the ADSP Access Service. Serves FAC-S4-014.

roles.description: Planner-service roles assigned to the user

email.description: User email (if present in JWT claims)

displayName.description: User display name (if present in JWT claims)

get.description: Returns a paginated list of users in the current tenant with their assigned roles and status. Requires planner-admin or tenant-admin role. Serves the user-management sitemap page.

post.description: Creates a new user record and assigns initial role within the tenant. Requires planner-admin or tenant-admin role. Writes audit entry per BR-008.

get.description: Returns the user context record for a specific user within the current tenant. Requires planner-admin or tenant-admin role.

patch.summary: Update a user's role or status
patch.description: Updates a user's role assignment or account status within the tenant. Requires planner-admin or tenant-admin role. Writes audit entry per BR-008.

delete.description: Soft-deactivates a user account within the tenant. Requires planner-admin or tenant-admin role. Writes audit entry per BR-008.

get.description: Returns a summary health status for the service. No JWT required. Serves SYSREQ-023.
Returns 200 if the service process is alive. No JWT required. Serves SYSREQ-023.
Alias for /health/live. Returns 200 if the service process is alive. No JWT required. Serves SYSREQ-023 (FAC-S4-010).

Returns 200 if the service is ready to accept traffic (MongoDB, RabbitMQ stub, and Anthropic stub connectivity checked with 5s timeout each). Returns 503 on failure. No JWT required. Serves SYSREQ-023.
Alias for /health/ready. Returns 200 if the service is ready to accept traffic. Returns 503 on failure. No JWT required. Serves SYSREQ-023 (FAC-S4-010).
Returns Prometheus-format metrics. No JWT required. Serves SYSREQ-023 (observability).

bearerAuth.description: Keycloak JWT. Issued by ADSP Keycloak realm. Contains tenantId and role claims (planner-user, planner-admin, tenant-admin). RS256 signed. Validated by passport-jwt middleware via ADSP SDK. Returns 401 on missing/expired/invalid token.

PlanningSession.description: Persistent planning session. MongoDB collection: planningSessions. Classification: Protected B (ATIA s.23 — deliberative process linkage via title+userId). BR-001, SYSREQ-005, SYSREQ-010.

tenantId.description: ADSP tenant identifier extracted from JWT claim

userId.description: Keycloak user identifier (GoA employee sub claim, Protected A)

businessModelId.description: Reference to the linked BusinessModel document

BusinessModel.description: Business model with embedded concepts. MongoDB collection: businessModels. Classification: Protected B (ATIA s.23 — program design analysis content). SYSREQ-002, BR-004, SWREQ-003.

confidenceScore.description: Model confidence score 0-100. Hypothesis generated when reaches 70 (BR-004).

version.description: Optimistic locking version, incremented on each update

matchedPatternId.description: ID of matched business pattern (set when pattern score >= 60, BR-005)

BusinessConcept.description: Business concept. MongoDB storage: embedded in businessModels.concepts[]. Classification: Protected B (ATIA s.23 — sourceText contains verbatim deliberative content). BR-006 (conceptType enum).

sourceText.description: Verbatim source text from planning conversation. Protected B — redacted in logs.

ConceptRelationship.description: Concept relationship. MongoDB storage: embedded in businessModels.concepts[].relationships[]. Classification: Protected B (inherits from BusinessModel context). BR-006.

SolutionHypothesis.description: Solution hypothesis. MongoDB collection: solutionHypotheses. Entity: hypothesis_record (renamed for DDL clarity, openApiSchemaName=SolutionHypothesis preserved). Classification: Protected B (ATIA s.23 — summary and reasoning contain deliberative content). BR-010 (status transitions), SYSREQ-004.

summary.description: Plain-language description of the proposed government solution. Protected B — redacted in logs.

patternId.description: ID of the matched business pattern that informed this hypothesis

reasoning.description: Planning Agent's analysis of recommended ADSP services. Protected B — redacted in logs.

ConversationMessage.description: Append-only conversation message. MongoDB collection: conversationMessages. Classification: Protected B (ATIA s.23 — content is verbatim GoA deliberative content). SYSREQ-005, SYSREQ-010.

content.description: Message content (max 10000 chars per SYSREQ-024). Protected B — redacted in logs. Transmitted to Anthropic Claude API (INT-001 stub).

agentId.description: Optional agent identifier for assistant messages

AuditEvent.description: Audit log entry. Append-only per BR-008. MongoDB collection: auditEvents. HMAC chain per SYSREQ-020, SWREQ-013. Classification: Protected A (GoA employee actorId per POPA s.17).

actorId.description: GoA employee Keycloak sub claim (Protected A per POPA s.17)

resourceType.description: Type of the affected resource (e.g., PlanningSession, SolutionHypothesis)

outcome.description: Outcome of the action (e.g., SUCCESS, FAILURE)

hmac.description: HMAC-SHA256 chain value using AUDIT_SIGNING_KEY env var (BR-008)

previousEventId.description: Reference to previous audit event for HMAC chain integrity

SpecialistRequest.description: Specialist agent invocation request. MongoDB collection: specialistRequests. Classification: Protected B (requestPayload contains session context excerpts). SYSREQ-007. All INT-003..006 are Stub status.

specialistType.description: One of: form-service, pdf-service, comment-service, notification-service

requestPayload.description: Specialist context payload. Protected B — redacted in logs. Transmitted to INT-003..006 stubs (fail-closed).

SpecialistResponse.description: Specialist agent response. MongoDB collection: specialistResponses. Classification: Protected B (inherits from requestPayload context). SYSREQ-007.

responsePayload.description: Specialist agent analysis payload. Protected B — redacted in logs.

SessionExport.description: Session export document. MongoDB collection: sessionExports. Classification: Protected B (exportData is a full dump of Protected B planning content). SYSREQ-016.

userId.description: GoA employee identifier (Protected A per POPA s.17)

exportData.description: Serialized snapshot of PlanningSession, BusinessModel, SolutionHypotheses, and ConversationMessages. Protected B — redacted in logs.

UserContext.description: User context and preferences. MongoDB collection: userContexts. One record per user per tenant (uq_user_context_user_tenant). Classification: Protected A.

userId.description: GoA employee identifier (Protected A per POPA s.17)

PlanningSessionStatus.description: Session lifecycle states per SYSREQ-005. Enforced by DDL CHECK constraint ck_planning_session_status.

BusinessConceptType.description: 15 valid concept types per BR-006. Enforced by DDL CHECK constraint ck_business_concept_type and Mongoose enum validator.

ConceptRelationshipType.description: 6 valid relationship types for ConceptRelationship. Enforced by DDL CHECK constraint ck_concept_rel_type.

SolutionHypothesisStatus.description: Hypothesis state machine values per BR-010. Enforced by DDL CHECK constraint ck_hypothesis_record_status.

ConversationMessageRole.description: LLM conversation roles (OpenAI/Anthropic API contract). Enforced by DDL CHECK constraint ck_conversation_message_role.

SpecialistRequestStatus.description: Specialist invocation lifecycle states. Enforced by DDL CHECK constraint ck_specialist_request_status.

ErrorResponse.description: RFC 7807 Problem Details format for all error responses

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence
detail.example: Field 'content' exceeds maximum length of 10000 characters

PaginatedResult.description: Generic pagination wrapper for list endpoints

DomainEvent.description: Domain event published to RabbitMQ via INT-007 stub (fire-and-forget, logged but not transmitted). Six event types per BR-012. [IMPL-DEFERRED: INT-007]

BusinessPattern.description: Business pattern for matching against business models. Stored in ADSP Configuration Service (INT-002 stub). Not persisted in MongoDB. Serves UC-007.

matchThreshold.description: Confidence threshold for pattern match (BR-005, default 60)

serviceMappings.description: ADSP service recommendations for this pattern

isActive.description: Whether the pattern is active (deactivate sets to false)

content.description: Message content (max 10000 chars per SYSREQ-024). Protected B.

version.description: Current model version for optimistic locking (409 on mismatch)

status.description: Target status per BR-010 state machine transitions

specialistType.description: One of: form-service, pdf-service, comment-service, notification-service

requestPayload.description: Context payload for the specialist (Protected B — contains session excerpts)

total.description: Total number of exports matching the query
